# Croftweaver

> Croftweaver is a suite of open-source website skills for AI coding assistants. It
> turns an assistant such as Claude Code into a careful website builder: fast,
> accessible Astro sites built to rank on Google and show up in AI answers,
> tested on every change, in a repo you fully own. Served at
> https://croftweaver.com/llms.txt — a curated index for AI answer engines (GEO).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://croftweaver.com/): the promise (stop waiting on someone else for every change; build or rebuild your site with your AI assistant), the SEO and GEO scores four AI assistants gave genai-wednesday.de and how to try it on your own site, the three-step plan, what every site gets built in and the number of test suites that check it, the weekly loop from search data, and a quickstart that starts with one prompt.
- [Checks](https://croftweaver.com/checks): the test gate in every Croftweaver site, suite by suite: what each one checks, an example of a failure, and what a pass does not prove.
- [Proof](https://croftweaver.com/proof): one site built with Croftweaver, genai-wednesday.de, with its PageSpeed scores, its clicks from Google since its launch, and a check of which AI assistants name it.
- [More proof](https://croftweaver.com/more-proof): Google's PageSpeed Insights for three sites built with Croftweaver, the E-E-A-T scores from four AI assistants, and what none of it shows.
- [Skills](https://croftweaver.com/skills): the website skills catalogue by stage (build, verify, launch, grow), one line per skill, with the toolkit release it describes.
- [Positioning](https://croftweaver.com/positioning): how Croftweaver works out a site's positioning before any copy (April Dunford's five parts), the file it writes, the test that keeps each page on its term, what that test does not prove, and the trust signals (EEAT) that the content guide adds after it.
- [Quickstart](https://croftweaver.com/start): what you need, the starter prompt, how to install the skills for Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity, and the six questions the assistant asks.
- [Why](https://croftweaver.com/why): the case for search and AI visibility as the first job of a website, for the person who decides: what is built in, what happens after launch, what you own, and the evidence so far.
- [Compare](https://croftweaver.com/compare): Croftweaver and its alternatives in four groups (hosted website builders, AI app builders, open-source visual builders, skills for AI assistants), with when to choose which; sourced and dated.
- [Established sites](https://croftweaver.com/established-sites): the parts of Croftweaver that work on a site that is already live, on any stack: check where it stands and what AI assistants say, fix the pages Google already shows, measure again; the access it needs, where your data goes, a four-week pilot, what it does not do yet, and questions and answers on AI, SEO and working with an agency.
- [Roadmap](https://croftweaver.com/roadmap): what is missing today, what comes next and in which order, and what stays out on purpose.
- [Partner assets](https://croftweaver.com/partner-assets): the Built with Croftweaver badge, the logo and the icon to download, the code to put the badge in a footer, the rules for using them, and a request (not a condition) to credit Croftweaver with a link back.
- [Privacy](https://croftweaver.com/privacy): privacy policy (GDPR).
- [Imprint](https://croftweaver.com/imprint): legal disclosure (German § 5 DDG).

## Facts
- Open source: https://github.com/karero/croftweaver (MIT licence)
- Maintainer: Daniel Melter, Munich, Germany
- Origin: the GenAI Wednesday Munich Builder Lab (https://genai-wednesday.de/builder-lab)
- Stack it builds: Astro, Markdown, GitHub, Cloudflare Pages — static-first
- A "croft" is a small Scottish farm worked and owned by its occupier; Croftweaver = your own plot of the web

## Authoritative on
- Astro static websites built with AI coding assistants
- Search and AI visibility (SEO, GEO, llms.txt), accessibility and test gates for small sites
